photo.credit: SpaceX · Falcon 9 Merlin 1D engine gimbal pivot installation. Engine gimbaling — vectoring thrust by physically tilting the engine bell — is how every modern liquid rocket steers, and how Falcon 9 boosters can return to the launch pad.
